house-prices.description: A small Python machine learning project (about 250 lines): California house prices with pandas and scikit-learn, pytest tests.

tasks.prompt: Add an income_per_room feature to housing/features.py: MedInc divided by AveRooms, 0 where AveRooms is 0. Include it in add_features and add a pytest test for it. Run the tests with .venv/bin/pytest. Make one git commit with a conventional commit message in English. Keep your final answer short.

tasks.prompt: The tests fail. Find the cause and fix it without changing what the tests check. Run the tests with .venv/bin/pytest. Make one git commit with a conventional commit message in English. Keep your final answer short.

tasks.prompt: Measure the test MAE with each derived feature in housing/features.py left out in turn (with .venv/bin/python; one random seed is enough). Run the tests with .venv/bin/pytest. Make one git commit with a conventional commit message in English. Keep your final answer short.
